english.title: Aid / abet a dishonest false statement / representation to obtain social security benefit / advantage / payment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), aided, abetted, counselled or procured, **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to dishonestly make a false

(A)_[statement, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE STATEMENT..),]_
(B)_[representation, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE REPRESENTATION..),]_

(C)_[to the Department for Work and Pensions]_
(D)_[to a local authority, namely **(.. SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..)]_

with a view to obtaining a benefit, advantage or payment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE BENEFIT / ADVANTAGE / PAYMENT ENTITLED TO..), for

(E)_[himself]_
(F)_[herself]_
(G)_[another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 111A(1)(a) and (3) of the Social Security Administration Act 1992 and section 8 of the Accessories and Abettors Act 1861.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
aid / abetted / counselled / procured a person
to dishonestly make a false statement / representation
with a view to obtaining a benefit / advantage / payment
for him / herself / another

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence inserted by Section 13 of the Social Security Administration (Fraud) Act 1997, as amended by the Child Support, Pensions and Social Security Act 2000, Schedule 6 to the Child Support, Pensions and Social Security Act 2000 and Schedule 6 to the Child Support, Pensions and Social Security Act 2001.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Helpu / annog datganiad / sylw anwir yn anonest i gael budd-dal / mantais / taliad nawdd cymdeithasol

welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 111A(1)(a) a (3) Deddf Nawdd Cymdeithasol a Chynnal Plant 1992 ac adran 8 Deddf Affeithwyr ac Ategwyr 1861.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Seven years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
